hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/paynes-prairie-preserve-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('Each site has ... nearby water and electric service', 'Most RV sites have 30-amp electric service, but a few have 50-amp service') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 30 RV-or-tent units Water Hookup; 13 list 50-amp, the rest 30-amp), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 30 back-in RV-or-tent sites with limerock surfaces in a heavily shaded campground near Lake Wauburg, plus 15 walk-in tent-only sites (19-33). Reserve Florida lists the RV sites at 45-60 ft; the park page gives a 58-ft maximum. The park gate locks at sunset; registered campers get a gate combination. No internet access in the park.

values.note: Reserve on the Florida State Parks reservations website (Reserve Florida) or at 800-326-3521. The primitive sites on the Chacala Trail (1.85 miles in) are booked 48 hours ahead through the ranger station.

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 30 back-in RV sites (plus 15 walk-in tent sites), 30-amp with a few 50-amp, water, max 58 ft, showers and dump station, no internet, reservable.
